EC1: Fasting plasma glucose [OR] > 7,0 mM, HbA1c > 48 mmol/mol 3 months after RYGB
EC2: Dysregulated thyroid diseases [OR], use of antithyroid treatment.
EC3: Late diabetic complications as retinopathy [OR], renal insufficiency [OR], neuropathy [OR] or previous pancreatitis.
EC4: Complications [AND] to RYGB. Documented reactive hypoglycaemia [OR], severe dumping (vomiting [OR], diarrhea [OR], severe abdominal pain after food intake)
